title: Push for twice as long
hook: Change force duration and predict impulse magnitude.
misconception: impulse magnitude stays fixed when force duration doubles.
objective: Apply J = FΔt to compare impulse magnitude when force duration changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a constant force acting in one direction, J = FΔt. When force duration doubles, impulse magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model J = FΔt; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a constant force acting in one direction, with a nonzero initial result. If force duration triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on impulse magnitude?
recall.why: Apply J = FΔt under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
